operational_run_directory: data/newgrad/inbox/ (gitignored batch drop; reports via --report to any path)

claude_invocation.method: local CLI session on the operator machine (same checkout Antigravity uses for research artifacts)
claude_invocation.note: No programmatic Muse API is used. Antigravity invokes Muse per the operator's existing setup and hands over the batch file path plus run_id; see docs/newgrad/automation.md section 6.

publication.mechanism: git push of a data-only commit to origin/master from an isolated worktree; existing Vercel GitHub integration auto-deploys master
publication.note: Enabled flag lives in data/newgrad/publication.json. Initial build leaves it disabled.

verification_procedure: 1. Validate the batch: npm run newgrad:ingest -- --batch <file> --dry-run (exit 0, review JSON report).
3. Validate the dataset: npm run newgrad:validate (exit 0).
4. Run the test suite: npm run verify:newgrad (exit 0).
5. Confirm git status shows changes only under data/newgrad/ (plus the report path, outside the repo).
6. Render check: npm run build, then confirm /newgrad reflects the run freshness timestamps.
7. Publish only when enabled: npm run newgrad:publish -- --run <run_id> --push; on failure, public data is untouched and the local update is retained for retry.
